name: Mairsil, called the Pretender
description: A power whose weakening loosened Barl's Cage; also called the Pretender.

description_citations.text: The Dark: card flavor text (The Dark, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Lord Ith's cage weakens as Mairsil's power wanes after a dozen years.
timeline.quote: For a dozen years the Cage had held Lord Ith, but as the Pretender Mairsil's power weakened, so did the bars.

citation.text: Barl's Cage (The Dark, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mairsil orders a great Calendar drawn up to show when the paths to the Dark Lands were strongest.
timeline.quote: The Pretender Mairsil ordered a great Calendar drawn up to show when the paths to the Dark Lands were strongest.

citation.text: Stone Calendar (The Dark, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: The Cage's bars weaken as his power weakens.
relations.quote: as the Pretender Mairsil's power weakened, so did the bars

citation.text: Barl's Cage (The Dark, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
